svg.title: AntiKebo
svg.desc: An alarm for deep sleepers that keeps ringing on every device, scolds you and messages you through your AI agent until you solve a challenge. 48 MCP tools; Web + PC and desk clock; 1 answer stops every device.
svg.text: An alarm for deep sleepers that keeps ringing on every device, scolds you and
messages you through your AI agent until you solve a challenge.
